title: 420Explorer EXP-0 final audit reconciliation closeout

exp_0_1.scope: repository inventory, ownership, contract/address and implementation-baseline qualification

exp_0_3.scope: authoritative Genesis scope, requirements, acceptance tests, status freeze, exclusions, conflicts, traceability and governance scope resolution

exp_0_4.scope: qualification evidence, historical closeouts, provenance, CI coverage, AC evidence, contradiction reconciliation, canonical ledger, retention, current-main reconciliation and final closeout

handoff.EXP_1: Resolve blockchain data integrity/runtime blockers including deployed Indexer endpoint, RPC binding, validator provider and historical attribution.
handoff.EXP_2: Qualify Explorer service/API runtime semantics including fees, receipts, raw events and attribution surfaces.
handoff.EXP_3: Qualify ProtocolRegistry deployment/publication plus ABI/descriptor runtime provenance.
handoff.EXP_4: Qualify deployed Explorer UI workflows and required displays.
handoff.EXP_5: Qualify ecosystem integrations against deployed dependencies.
handoff.EXP_6: Qualify security, degraded-state, recovery, performance and operational resilience.
handoff.EXP_7: Qualify production-equivalent deployment and live-network evidence.
handoff.EXP_8: Run exact release-candidate qualification, satisfy AC-1 through AC-10, close blockers and perform final Genesis closeout.

final_closeout_rules: EXP-0 is complete only as audit, scope, evidence and repository reconciliation.
No EXP-0 artifact may be read as runtime, deployment, live-network or Genesis qualification.
The ten active Genesis blockers remain authoritative until later owners close them with required evidence.
AC-1 through AC-10 remain unverified until later qualification procedures and exact release-candidate closeout establish satisfaction.
Governance remains descriptive subject matter but is not a mandatory dedicated Explorer Genesis view.
The exact EXP-0.4.10 implementation head and the final evidence-recording head must both pass the retained Indexer, Docs and Integrated qualification suites.
